_comment: Human-verified Booklet A question start positions, applied by
build/index_mcq.py. These exist because both automatic recovery tiers can
fail on the same gap at once.
2026 Red Swastika Q7 is the case this was built for: Q6's own fourth option
is a picture (a bar-chart graph) with no printed digit OCR can read, so the
option-block recovery tier never sees Q6's own set of four complete on
Q6's own page -- it runs on into Q7's own options before noticing, lands
exactly on Q8's own row, and is rejected as out of bounds. Position-based
recovery has nothing to go on either, since Q7's number is genuinely absent
from the print, not merely misread.
Confirmed by eye against the scan and with the paper's provider: Q7 begins
at the top of the page recorded here -- the same rule the automatic tiers
already use when a question overleaf owns its page from the top.
This file is committed on purpose. work-a/ is gitignored and regenerated,
so a verified reading recorded only there would be lost on the next
rebuild. Keys are question number; values are the page it starts on.
